verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Reverse Mabakusenko as a Ki Blast Ultimate and Counter Skill with a short-range universal counter and 300 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Skill Shop as the unlock route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes a shop route rather than a Parallel Quest reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Reverse Mabakusenko is kept distinct from related Piccolo techniques and from other counter skills.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.

records.name: Reverse Mabakusenko
records.character_source: Piccolo, Pikkon, Gohan (Beast), and customizable partners documented by current references
records.skill_description: Enter a counter stance and, if timed against an incoming attack, retaliate with a powerful Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: The user enters a counter stance for approximately two seconds. If attacked during the active window, the counter fires a Ki Wave at the opponent. Current reference material classifies it as a beam, universal counter, short-range, multi-hit and knockback Ultimate. Gohan (Beast) has a character-specific damage interaction that is retained as a note rather than creating a duplicate skill identity.
